summary: Restart the black-box API against its already-migrated schema
details: Keep the first development API startup responsible for preparing the disposable demo schema, then explicitly skip migrations when restarting the API while its worker remains live.
Check that the worker survives the API restart, retaining the existing persistence, tenant-isolation, readiness, package, audit-chain and outbox assertions.

compatibility.notes: Validation fixture only. Production still requires a separate migration job and runtimes retain their shared schema leases.

security: Preserve exclusive migration coordination and shared runtime schema leases; do not attempt migrations while the demo worker is serving the same schema.
limitations: The disposable demo uses development startup migration for its first API; it does not prove an operator-managed production rollout.
Full production qualification remains required before EVY-1206 is complete.
